Messages.Author: Francois Gombault
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I'm having trouble to find Sabbat War starters here in France (I tried
Ostelen and StarPlayer in Paris, and most shops in Nice)

Every shopkeeper tells me they can't get any.

Is this :
- My paranoia ?
- Some local, temporary problem ?
- Something bigger happening (starters no longer in production) ?

--
Francois,

feeling somehow futile, given the context in the US. All our
feelings goes to the victims of that terrible terrorist strike.

Starters are no longer in production. Neither are boosters.
The same is true of Final Nights.

Sabbat War sold out (at the distributor level) almost as soon as it was
released. It was reprinted and sold out again in January of this year.

Messages.Author: Michael Edwards (aka Shadowdragon)
Messages.Body:


By the speed in which the new V:TES card are selling out it should be
obvious the demand is very high. I think it would be a shame not to
reprint Sabbat War and Final Nights. We didn't even get Final Nights in
the stores where I live and we only got one box of Sabbat War starters
and one box of Sabbat War boosters. It would be extremely annoying to
hear that Sabbat War and Final Nights were out of print so soon after
their release.

Michael

Messages.Body:

Shadowdragon)" <mtbed...@home.com> writes

>By the speed in which the new V:TES card are selling out it should be
>obvious the demand is very high.

This is not a give, by any means. Speed of sale does not necessarily
mean anything unless you take into account how much was printed.

White Wolf can also usually only rely on the sales statistics with/from
distributors, rather than stores.
